lines.text: Brihat Jataka
Notes: The conveyance can refer to an animal like a horse.
If the Moon is in the tenth and the Sun is in the seventh, the
Moon is not weak. He will be weak in the first three degrees of
Scorpio.
वीर्यान्वितक्रवीक्षिते क्षीणेन्दौ निधनस्थितेऽर्कजे।
गुह्योद्धवरोगपीडया मृत्यु: स्यात्क्रमिशस्त्रदाहज: ।। 9 ।।
When a powerful Mars aspects a weak Moon who is with
Shani in the eighth, the person dies from worms, fire or
instruments involved in a surgical treatment of the private
parts.
अस्ते रवौ सरुधिरे निधनेऽर्कपुत्रे
क्षीणे रसातलगते हिमगौ खगान्त:।
लग्नात्मजाष्टमतप:स्विनभौममन्द
चन्द्रैस्तु शैलशिखराशनिकुडचपातै:।। 10 ।।
The Sun must be with Kuja in the seventh, Shani is to be
in the eighth and weak Moon is to be in the fourth. Then the
death is from birds.
If the Sun, Kuja, Shani and Moon are respectively in
houses 1, 5, 8 and 9, the native dies by falling from the top of
a mountain, or from a wall, or by lightning.
द्वाविंश: कथितस्तु कारणं द्रेष्काणो निधनस्य सूरिभि:।
तस्याधिपतिर्भवोऽपि वा निर्याणं स्वगुणै: प्रयच्छति।। 11 ।।
The scholars in astrology argue that the twenty second
drekkana indicates the nature of death. Death is caused by the
nature of the lord of drekkana or by the nature of the owner of
the sign having that drekkana.
Notes: This refers to cases where there is no planet in
the eighth, where the eighth is not aspected by any planet,
and where the previously mentioned combinations do not
apply.
